title: NIST WebBook: Methane is CH4, molecular weight 16.0425 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Methane as CH4, molecular weight 16.0425 amu, CAS 74-82-8.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Methane, CAS Registry Number 74-82-8, lists molecular formula CH4 and molecular weight 16.0425 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 16.0313001 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/CH4/h1H4. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
